about: Step content that is neither data nor route, anchored on a quest's goal: a step's tip (tip), a goal's inline note (goalNote), a goal that never holds the route (optional: true), a level gate before the goal (level), the goal's step shown only from a level (when: "level>=N"), a take on the way (early: { after: { quest, goal }, title, when?, tip? }, an along step right after the step of `after` listing the accept and its objectives until the quest's own step), or a slow, zone-wide collection worked over the stay (background: { title, tip?, mobs, mention?, finish: { title, tip?, map, x, y } }, on an objective: an `along until … background` step from the accept to the hand-in, a finish step before the hand-in, the mention in the steps between that pass the mobs). at: { quest, goal: accept | turnin | complete | objective, objective? }. forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }) and its issue or pr.
